card.name: Stance or group words in formal prose
card.fires_on: Abstract nouns and adjectives in formal or political prose, often right after a verb or adjective, such as 'attitude', 'minority', 'urge' or 'high'. Also the word 'Steps' starting a sentence in a warning section.

modes.label: Minority as a group
modes.description: The word minority or Minority used for a smaller political or social group.
modes.example: on grounds that it would harm<< minority>> voter turnout.

modes.label: Stance or urging words
modes.description: A word of attitude or insistence in political statements, such as attitude or urge.
modes.example: China has always had a prudent and responsible<< attitude>> toward arm sales.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Steps
modes.description: The word Steps starting a sentence after a list of risk factors.
modes.example: and hepatic impairment.<< Steps>> to reduce the risk of and manage met
